title: Separate the cartesian lift and clopen section factors before taking mates
statement: Let R_n be arbitrary commutative rings with transitions, and use the module-system categories, exact pullback and open extension of [def-sp-varying-ring-operations]. For exact functors F,G,H,K define localizedArrow(t), for t:F G -> H K, by conjugating the exact localization of its degreewise chain transformation with the two mapDerivedCategoryCompIso comparisons. For a cartesian open square define openBaseChange as localizedArrow of the specified moduleBeta hom of [def-sp-varying-ring-proper-open-arrows]. For a proper/open square k:V->W, r:V->S, p:W->T, i:S->T with kp=ri and quasi-compact open k,i, let q:W times_T S->S, b:W times_T S->W and s=(k,r). Define moduleSectionArrow:q^* b_! -> r^* k_! to be q^* pi_s followed by the associators and the specified open and pullback composition/equality comparisons bs=k and qs=r. Define sectionArrow by exact localization of this ordinary map. Define strictSectionArrow by the identical expression in the strict-tower derived calculus [lem-cbc-strict-tower-proper-open-calculus]. Then alpha is openBaseChange followed by sectionArrow, and strict alpha is strict beta followed by strictSectionArrow. All these definitions are actual constructed maps, with no chosen existence witness.

proof.text: Localization.liftNatTrans preserves composition. Expanding localizedArrow(t) followed by localizedArrow(s) cancels the intermediate exact-composition isomorphism; comp_liftNatTrans_assoc identifies the two remaining lifts with the lift of t followed by s. Whiskering and mapHomologicalComplex also preserve composition.

    (p : W ⟶ T) (i : S ⟶ T) [IsOpenImmersion k] [IsOpenImmersion i]
    [QuasiCompact k] [QuasiCompact i] [IsProper r] [IsProper p]
    (h : k ≫ p = r ≫ i) :
    pull R φ (pullback.snd p i) ⋙ extension R φ (pullback.fst p i) ⟶
      pull R φ r ⋙ extension R φ k
